title: I Found a Genie and Wasted My Last Wish 🧞
description:
This story may be inspired by real events or jokes, but all names and details are fictional. Any resemblance to real people is coincidental.

#funny #storytime #genie #shorts
style: 3D animated cartoon movie style, expressive characters with big eyes, vibrant colours, cinematic lighting, vertical composition, highly detailed, no text, no letters, no watermark

scenes.text: I was cleaning my grandpa's attic when I rubbed an old lamp. And a genie actually came out.
scenes.image: a skinny nerdy guy about 30 with glasses and a messy t-shirt in a dusty attic rubbing a brass lamp, a big blue cartoon genie with a curled beard and golden bracelets, floating out of a lamp bursting out in smoke

scenes.text: He said, you get three wishes. Choose wisely.
scenes.image: a big blue cartoon genie with a curled beard and golden bracelets, floating out of a lamp holding up three glowing fingers

scenes.text: First wish: a million dollars. Boom. My room filled with cash.
scenes.image: a skinny nerdy guy about 30 with glasses and a messy t-shirt buried up to his neck in money, laughing

scenes.text: Second wish: a mansion by the beach. Boom. I was standing on a balcony looking at the ocean.
scenes.image: a skinny nerdy guy about 30 with glasses and a messy t-shirt on a mansion balcony overlooking a sunny beach, arms wide

scenes.text: For my last wish, I got greedy. I said, make me completely irresistible to women.
scenes.image: a skinny nerdy guy about 30 with glasses and a messy t-shirt winking and pointing at himself, a big blue cartoon genie with a curled beard and golden bracelets, floating out of a lamp raising an eyebrow

scenes.text: The genie smiled, snapped his fingers, and boom.
scenes.image: a big blue cartoon genie with a curled beard and golden bracelets, floating out of a lamp snapping his fingers with a mischievous grin, sparkles everywhere

scenes.text: I turned into a giant box of chocolates.
scenes.image: a giant heart-shaped box of chocolates with a tiny confused face, sitting in a mansion

scenes.text: Technically, he wasn't wrong. Never trust a genie with a sense of humour.
scenes.image: a big blue cartoon genie with a curled beard and golden bracelets, floating out of a lamp laughing and floating back into his lamp, the box of chocolates looking sad
